Game Overview

Sushi Escape is a arcade title where embark on a thrilling aerial adventure as a nimble nigiri in Sushi Escape. Navigate vibrant worlds filled with relentless obstacles using only the up arrow. Precision and timing are key, as you dodge dangers, collect soy sauces, and chase high scores. Get ready for an endlessly addictive sushi flight!
